scope: Bundled Onshape std 3083, official documentation, and authenticated differential FeatureScript execution in the user-designated Testing document. Differential coverage is scoped to the recorded fixtures; full parity is not certified.

definitions.verified-subset: Positive geometric assertions exist for the stated subset, not all modes or UI parity.
definitions.blocked: A known required operation/state is missing.
definitions.unverified: Source/primitives exist, but no positive end-to-end feature proof.

releaseExitCriteria: Positive std-feature fixtures for every option family with exact or tolerance-bound geometry, body kinds/counts and query/history assertions.
Cold rebuild after upstream parameter edits, failed edit recovery, undo/redo and save/reopen, in multiple configurations.
Differential fixtures from the matching Onshape version, including metadata, naming and documented expected failures.
No ignored shape-affecting inputs, no placeholder success, no last-good geometry reported as a successful rebuild.
Dedicated command/panel integration, selection rules and preview/commit behavior for all requested tools.

inspection.measure: Unit/filter controls implemented; mate-connector frames unavailable.
inspection.analysis: Ten requested menu entries inventoried; numerical geometry inspection and two-solid interference work. Eight advanced analyses/overlays remain unavailable.
inspection.mass: Part/planar Face modes and full centroid inertia tensor; uniform density only. Material densities, reference frame, overrides and certified variance are not implemented.

tools.limits: Fresh-context annular and disjoint regions, surface profiles, straight/curved paths and fixed versus path-normal orientation tested. Twist, scale, locked profiles and partial-path extents rejected. Stable subshape history and all boolean modes still need parity fixtures. Live Onshape comparisons now cover varying heights, physical edge queries excluding periodic seams, exact tight bounds, area, length and volume.

Simple solid profiles tested at multiple heights. Guides, connections, end constraints, periodicity, path sections and profiles with holes explicitly rejected. Live Onshape comparisons now cover varying heights, physical edge queries excluding periodic seams, exact tight bounds, area, length and volume.
Simple and symmetric face thickening and whole-sheet keepTools tested. Multi-face bodies are explicitly rejected until joined offset/junction semantics are implemented.
Closed and crossing sheets checked analytically. General curved enclosures and ambiguous/multiple regions need fixtures.
No host face-blend kernel operation.
Constant-radius edges have analytic-volume tests. Variable radius, full round, partial and conic options are not parity-certified.
Equal-distance chamfers have volume tests. Unequal distances, distance-angle and sheet-metal cases need fixtures.

Neutral-plane/reference-surface draft and the actual std draft feature match Onshape for tested angles, heights and reversed pull. Available through Insert custom feature. Parting lines, curved neutral surfaces and refilleting are rejected. Steep drafts requiring disappearing faces remain a recorded differential gap.
No body-draft kernel operation.

Shared kernel operation is now implemented, but this complete standard feature and its option families still need positive differential fixtures. Std rib relies on unimplemented draft and profile-extension paths; no positive end-to-end rib fixture.
Open box shell and thickness direction tested. Closed-shell, multi-face and curved-wall cases need broader fixtures.
Blind, counterbore, countersink, through-hole, slanted entry and face/profile query fixtures. Thread, standard table and all termination combinations are unverified.
Std source is available; thread attributes, undercut, chamfer and display semantics have no positive feature fixture. Curved face offsets are restricted.
Part-copy geometry tested. Face patterns are unsupported and feature reapply/boolean modes need positive fixtures.
Part-copy geometry tested. Face patterns are unsupported and feature reapply/boolean modes need positive fixtures.
Part-copy geometry tested. Face patterns are unsupported and feature reapply/boolean modes need positive fixtures.

Std curvePattern part patterns along a straight sketch edge and a circular arc: equal and distance spacing, default (tangent-following, refined through swept tangent planes) and keep-orientation, and skipped instances, checked by instance centroids and the turned instances' bounding boxes. Face and feature patterns, lock-faces orientation, closed paths and Onshape differential fixtures are missing.
Solid union/subtract/intersect volumes tested. Sheet unions, groups and keep-tool combinations need full parity coverage.
Part/face/edge splitting with planes and sketch tools tested. Full query/history and keep-side combinations remain incomplete.
Translation, rotation, uniform scaling and copying tested. Mate-connector, nonuniform scale and pattern interactions need fixtures.
No wrap kernel operation.
Std image/decal attributes do not establish texture placement, rendering or serialized asset portability. No positive visual fixture.
Body deletion and composite consumption tested. Every composite/sketch/linked-part combination is not covered.
Remove and change radius of a two-face fillet tested; other fillet geometries are restricted.
Boss/hole/fillet healing, planar caps and open void tested. Curved caps and general healing are not equivalent.
Planar normal translation/offset tested. Rotation and general curved-face editing are rejected.
Parallel planar replacement tested. Nonparallel/curved templates are rejected.
Mid-plane and basic plane geometry tested; all construction modes and selection identities need fixtures.
Surface extraction and planar offsets tested at operation level. Curved offsets are rejected; full feature behavior is not certified.

Two u profiles (linear interpolation, a ruled loft) and four single-edge u/v profiles (OCCT Coons patch) checked by area, bounds, edge count and boundary/center containment. The interior of a non-planar four-sided patch follows OCCT's Coons blend and is not differential-verified. Boundary conditions, multi-edge four-sided profiles and other profile counts are rejected.

Closed G0 planar/nonplanar boundaries and planar G1/G2 support cases match live Onshape; the actual std fill feature is covered. Position continuity is exposed through Insert custom feature. Guide vertices supported by the kernel; curved support/guide-point geometry, sampled guide curves and surface joins need differential coverage.

Blind extension of straight outer boundary edges of single-face planar sheets (edge picks, whole-sheet picks, tangent propagation along collinear edges) checked by area, bounds and the lengthened side edges keeping their identity. Curved and multi-face sheets, up-to-target conditions and negative distances (std trims those with opEdgeChange) are not supported.

ALIGNED_WITH_VECTOR ruled surfaces over line and arc paths perpendicular to the direction, both directions, checked by area, bounds, body count and face geometry types. Normal, tangent and angle-from-vector types, vertex overrides and paths not perpendicular to the direction are rejected with an error; no Onshape differential fixture.
Required host surface operation is missing.
Split/delete operations exist; trimming and merging two sheets has no positive feature fixture and sheet boolean behavior needs verification.
Pitch/turn helix length and cylinder-based std feature tested. Conical/spiral variants need fixtures.

Actual std fitSpline plus open/periodic, clamped-end and explicit-parameter cubic splines match live Onshape samples. Vertex mode is exposed through Insert custom feature. Interior derivatives explicitly rejected after a differential mismatch; second derivatives and target length remain unsupported. Edges mode joins a tangent-continuous chain into one exact B-spline edge (length and on-curve checks; corners rejected).

Curve-to-face projection along a direction (only what lies ahead of the curve, across several target faces) and normal to the target faces checked by wire count, length and bounds; normal projection is the kernel's approximation (length within 1e-3 mm). The two-sketch mode runs on existing extrude/boolean operations and is not covered here.

Wire bodies with a straight end edge: blind extension at the end nearest the help point (or the other end when flipped), extension up to a plane, and trimming back to a crossing plane (nearest end, or the help point's end), checked by length, bounds and the edge keeping its identity. Curved end edges (curvature/tangent extension shapes), trimming to points and extending without a help point are rejected.
Required host curve operation is missing.

Planar target faces: single straight and circular edges (and tangent-continuous chains) offset across their face into parallel lines and concentric arcs/circles, and offset-and-extend of single straight edges clipped to the face boundary, checked by length and bounds. Offsets leaving the face, corners between edges (gap fill), curved faces and splitting (offset, extend and split) are rejected; trimming to points is not supported by opMoveCurveBoundary yet; approximation is untested here.
opEditCurve (the wire takes another curve's geometry) is implemented and exercised through curve approximation; the edit curve feature's control-point editing has no positive fixture.
Straight bridge between two points and rational B-spline primitives tested. Tangency/curvature matching and higher-degree bridges need fixtures.

A tangent line-and-arc chain extracted into one wire and approximated: the fitted B-spline replaces the wire's curve (opEditCurve), checked by wire count, spline geometry, length and path deviation (under 5 µm at a 1 µm tolerance). The approximation's accuracy between samples is approximateSpline's; non-approximated chains, closed chains and Onshape differential fixtures are not covered here.
Intersection of faces has a geometric fixture. Complex multi-surface intersections need coverage.

Explicit normalized positions on a cylinder face checked: constant-height circles at symmetric fractions and full-height straight rulings. U and V follow the kernel's surface parameterization, which may differ from Onshape's on some surface types; equal spacing (auto-spaced curves) is rejected and picked-point positions are untested.

Shared kernel operation is now implemented, but this complete standard feature and its option families still need positive differential fixtures. Spline generation and routing edits are not end-to-end tested.
Context merge is tested; importing a real Onshape document/configuration and preserving identities is not. Chili3D cross-document links are a separate implementation.
Queries and variable storage are implemented, but this feature needs positive selection-mode, naming, downstream use and rebuild fixtures.
Open/closed composites, constituents, modification and queries tested. Serialization and cross-app metadata round trips need fixtures.
Generic attributes are implemented. Frame-profile tags, alignment points, custom columns and downstream frame use lack end-to-end fixtures.
constructPaths is implemented (`onshape/pathBuiltins.ts`, tested on its own); the frame feature's profile import, path construction, corners, trimming and identity behaviour have no positive fixture.
Split and boolean primitives exist; frame-group trim and retained metadata need positive frame fixtures.
Requires frame semantics and geometry fixtures; source presence does not verify production gussets.

Shared kernel operation is now implemented, but this complete standard feature and its option families still need positive differential fixtures. Filling the profile boundary is unavailable; offsets are restricted to planar faces.
Custom-table infrastructure exists; actual frame grouping, length/angle, overrides and persistence need fixtures.

testCaveats: onshapeStdLayers.kernel.test.ts allows an exact known-missing-builtin list and accepts domain failures; its success is not behavioral parity.
stdFeatures.kernel.test.ts retains an expected failure for evDistance from a point to a part. A green suite does not establish full evDistance compatibility.
Subset tests outside onshapeConformance.kernel.test.ts assert analytic geometry against local OCCT; they are not differential executions inside Onshape.
The live differential suite covers 29 cases and retains two explicit known gaps. Passing regression tests does not imply all comparisons pass; compare:onshape remains nonzero for known gaps.

knownGaps: Drafts that require a face to disappear (fail without mutating the source body).
differential.tolerances: Absolute 1e-5 plus relative 1e-6 for measurements; exact topology counts. The documented approximate arc-length evaluator is compared at 0.001 mm, recorded per case. Native-parameter curve samples retain the strict default.
differential.gate: The regression tests assert the exact known gaps. The comparison command exits nonzero while any incompatibility remains, including known gaps.
